caption: The drawing depicts a double wooden door with an arched frame, set in a masonry wall. The doors are light brown with visible wood grain and are divided into rectangular panels. Each panel has a decorative octagonal medallion in the center and small round metallic studs placed in symmetric patterns. The arch above the door is outlined with pinkish-purple shading and adorned with ornate floral and vine-like carvings at either side of the top, with a central decorative crest featuring a shield and crossed elements. Below the door, there is a pale blue-gray step leading to a foreground of red, unevenly shaped tiles or bricks. The architectural wall around the door is shaded in soft, light beige with pinkish-purple accents emphasizing the indented lines and frame. The artist’s signature, “P. Jiménez,” appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Doorway and Wall Painting
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
